sections.title: Player-facing description
sections.body: Two trees step where trees should not step. Roots lift like legs, branches crook like claws, and amber hollows in the bark watch the path.

sections.title: Public role
sections.body: Sablewood plant hazard and village-scale threat

sections.title: Handout text
sections.body: Player-safe note: Walking predatory trees with root legs, hooked branch arms, hollow amber eyes, and bark faces that make ordinary forest scenery feel like it might choose a target.

sections.title: GM truth
sections.body: No forced reveal. Let this entity disclose truth through scene context and player attention.

sections.title: GM handling
sections.body: Use as environment-scale threat unless Kyle turns them into a combat scene; their horror is village pressure, not a random tree fight.
